name: Adobe Creative Cloud

fastest.text: Sign in at account.adobe.com, select Manage plan under Plans and payment, then Cancel your plan.

steps: Sign in to your Adobe account at account.adobe.com.
In Plans and payment, select Manage plan for the plan you want to cancel.
Select Cancel your plan, check the details and select Continue to cancel.
Pick a reason, select Continue, review the details and select Confirm cancellation.
note: Have more than one Adobe plan? Each one has to be cancelled separately. Bought through Google or Microsoft? Cancel with them.

faq.a: On an annual plan paid monthly, cancelling after the first 14 days costs 50% of what's left on the contract. Cancel within 14 days of buying and most plans get a full refund.

faq.q: Do I keep access after cancelling?
faq.a: Yes. Paid apps and services keep working until the end of the current billing period, and your Adobe account stays with its free benefits.
Yes. While you're still in the billing period, you can reactivate the plan from your Adobe account.

faq.q: Why can't I cancel right now?
faq.a: You can't cancel while a payment is processing or has a problem. Wait 24 hours and try again.
